How to use this calculator

  1. Enter number of dice, sides per die.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How dice roller is calculated

Simulate one or more fair dice with a chosen number of sides and report each roll plus the total. Secure runtime randomness is used when available; every face from 1 through the selected side count has equal probability. Rolling two six-sided dice can produce totals from 2 through 12. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. The calculator uses the platform’s secure random API when available, but it is for casual play rather than audited gambling. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

Dice Roller is calculated from the supplied measurement fields using the units shown.
A worked example

Rolling two six-sided dice can produce totals from 2 through 12.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.
